notes:
## Fixes

- **Studios are named from file names reliably.** Refresh Contents and Refresh All Available now check every scene in the folder, not only videos the refresh hadn't seen before. Before, scenes already in your collection were never checked.
  - Joined-up names count too: *NorthlightFilmsBeachDay* now matches Northlight Films.
  - A studio is only ever added this way once, so one you take off a scene stays off.
